items.label: Breaking
items.text: Rapture countdown clock reboots after daylight saving time; congregation advised to remain imminently flexible.

items.label: Developing
items.text: Third Temple livestream launches soft-open; chat moderators banning anyone asking where the Ark is.

items.label: Update
items.text: Prophecy conference releases revised badge lanyards after speaker identifies Antichrist as three different guys before lunch.

items.label: Report
items.text: Newspaper exegesis team upgrades to color-coding system to keep Ezekiel, energy prices, and El Niño from overlapping again.

items.label: Watch
items.text: Blood moon spotted over strip-mall Jerusalem replica; gift shop announces limited-edition prophetic hoodie drop.

items.label: Developing
items.text: Left Behind book club adds silent Rapture contingency chapter for members who keep waking up still employed.
